info.title: Mailhive Send API
info.description: Send transactional email from your verified domains, and manage the audiences and contacts your broadcasts go to. Guides: https://mailhive.africa/docs

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeating the same request with the same key within 24 hours returns the original response instead of sending again. The same key with a different request is a 409 idempotency_conflict.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeating the same request with the same key within 24 hours returns the original response instead of sending again. The same key with a different request is a 409 idempotency_conflict.

get.description: Needs an API key with Full access; a sending-only key gets 403 insufficient_scope.

post.description: Needs an API key with Full access; a sending-only key gets 403 insufficient_scope.

patch.description: Needs an API key with Full access; a sending-only key gets 403 insufficient_scope. Deleting an audience is only possible from the dashboard.

get.description: Needs an API key with Full access; a sending-only key gets 403 insufficient_scope.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Find one person by exact email address (case-insensitive).

post.description: Adds one person. 409 `contact_exists` if their address is already in the audience: use PUT to add or update. Needs an API key with Full access; a sending-only key gets 403 insufficient_scope.

put.description: Adds the person, or updates them if they're already in the audience: 201 when created, 200 when updated. Names you leave out are kept (send an empty string to clear one); custom `fields` are merged in (an empty value removes a field). Someone who unsubscribed or marked your email as spam is never made subscribed again by this call: see `double_opt_in`. Needs an API key with Full access; a sending-only key gets 403 insufficient_scope.

post.summary: Add or update up to 100 contacts
post.description: Each entry is handled as PUT would. One bad entry doesn't stop the rest. Counts as one request per entry against the contacts rate limit. Needs an API key with Full access; a sending-only key gets 403 insufficient_scope.

200.description: A result for each entry, in order

get.description: Needs an API key with Full access; a sending-only key gets 403 insufficient_scope.

200.description: The contact with its recent emails

patch.description: Edits names and fields, or unsubscribes the contact. There's no re-subscribing here: only the person can, by confirming a double opt-in email. Needs an API key with Full access; a sending-only key gets 403 insufficient_scope.

delete.description: Deleting someone who unsubscribed keeps their address suppressed, so they can't be added back as subscribed. Needs an API key with Full access; a sending-only key gets 403 insufficient_scope.

post.summary: An email event (Mailhive-Event header names it)

from.title: From
from.description: Sender, at a verified sending domain: `hello@example.com` or `Acme <hello@example.com>`.

to.description: One recipient, or a list. At most 50 recipients across to, cc and bcc.

cc.description: Copied recipients: one address or a list.

bcc.description: Hidden recipients: one address or a list.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Required unless template_id is given. Up to 998 characters.

html.title: Html
html.description: HTML body. html or text (or both) is required unless template_id is given.

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: A template's id. Use instead of subject, html and text.

reply_to.description: Where replies go: one address or a list.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Extra headers: names starting X-, or In-Reply-To, References, List-Unsubscribe, List-Unsubscribe-Post. No line breaks in values.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Up to 10 of your own labels (names up to 64 characters, values up to 256). Returned in webhook events.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Files, up to 10 MB in total.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: 1 to 100 emails. All are sent, or none.

suppressed.description: Recipients dropped because they're on the suppression list.

test.description: True when sent with a test key (mhs_test_…): delivery is simulated and nothing is billed.
True when sent with a test key: delivery was simulated.

details.description: Extra information; for validation_error, a list of problems (type, loc, msg).

request_id.description: Identifies this request (also in the X-Request-Id header). Quote it when contacting support.

test.description: Present and true on events that aren't real: test events sent from the dashboard, and events for mail sent with a test key.

detail.description: Bounces and delays: code, response, bounce_classification. Clicks: url.

mailable.description: Of those, who a broadcast would reach.

ConfirmationRequest.description: Email the person a link to confirm. They're subscribed only if they click it; until then they're pending and never mailed by a broadcast. The link expires after 7 days and the pending contact is removed. The email is sent from one of your verified domains, and counts toward your plan's emails.

from.description: The From address, on a verified sending domain, e.g. `Acme <hello@acme.com>`.

fields.description: Custom fields. Up to 50; names are letters, digits, - or _ (up to 64 characters, starting with a letter); values up to 500 characters.

status.description: Defaults to subscribed for a new contact and leaves an existing one as it is. Someone who unsubscribed or marked your email as spam can't be set to subscribed: 409 `contact_unsubscribed`.

suppressed.description: On the organization's suppression list (hard bounce, spam complaint or unsubscribe): never mailed.

mailable.description: Subscribed and not suppressed: a broadcast would reach them.

test.description: Present and true when a test key made the call: nothing was saved or sent.

history.description: The most recent emails sent to them.

E403.description: send_not_activated, sending_paused or insufficient_scope (the key can only send email)

E429.description: rate_limited (retry after Retry-After), monthly_quota_reached or daily_cap_reached (don't retry automatically)

E409.description: idempotency_conflict (the Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request), contact_exists, or contact_unsubscribed (that person unsubscribed or reported spam, so you can't subscribe them again; use double_opt_in)

X-Request-Id.description: Identifies the request. Send your own (8–64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -) to have it echoed back.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per minute under the tightest limit this request counted against.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the current window resets.
